description: This file defines the AWS MediaConnectClient class, which extends the AwsClient class. It serves as a specialized client to interact with the AWS MediaConnect service, providing method signatures for various API operations such as creating, describing, deleting, and updating media flows, bridges, gateways, and other resources associated with MediaConnect. The class primarily contains method annotations and a class declaration, with no complex logic or implementation code.
